lines.zh: 石壳刮过石砖，火星落了一路。
lines.en: My stone hide scrapes the bricks, striking sparks.

lines.zh: 我走得像一尊会挪动的雕像。
lines.en: I walk like a statue that learned to move.

lines.zh: 翅膀收着，太重，飞不起来。
lines.en: My wings stay folded; they are too heavy to fly.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很沉，回声慢半拍。
lines.en: My steps are heavy; the echo lags half a beat.

lines.zh: 我沿着旧城墙走，那里的石头认得我。
lines.en: I walk the old walls; their stones know me.

lines.zh: 膝盖里的碎石互相磨着响。
lines.en: Grit grinds inside my knees with every step.

lines.zh: 每一步都让我掉一点石屑。
lines.en: Every step sheds a little stone dust.

lines.zh: 我绕开草地，踩上去会陷。
lines.en: I skirt the grass; it gives way beneath me.

lines.zh: 这双脚以前走的是商路。
lines.en: These feet once walked a merchant road.

lines.zh: 我习惯贴墙走，像以前巡逻那样。
lines.en: I hug the walls, as I did on patrol.

lines.zh: 拐角处，我的影子先探出半截。
lines.en: At the corner, my shadow leans out half a step first.

lines.zh: 走累了，我就找根石柱靠着。
lines.en: When tired, I lean against a stone pillar.

lines.zh: 我蹲在屋檐上，和滴水兽分不清。
lines.en: I crouch on the eaves, hard to tell from the drain spout.

lines.zh: 石缝里长苔，我也懒得抖掉。
lines.en: Moss grows in my seams; I do not bother shaking it off.

lines.zh: 风穿过翅膀骨，像吹空瓶。
lines.en: Wind through my wing bones sounds like a blown bottle.

lines.zh: 我在数屋檐下的燕子窝。
lines.en: I am counting the swallow nests under the eaves.

lines.zh: 我的头盔里还卡着一枚旧硬币。
lines.en: An old coin is still lodged in my helmet.

lines.zh: 没人叫我的名字，可名字还在头上。
lines.en: No one calls my name, yet it stays on my brow.

lines.zh: 我纹丝不动，鸟就落到我肩上。
lines.en: I stay perfectly still, and a bird lands on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 石头不需要呼吸，我却还想。
lines.en: Stone needs no breath, yet I still want to.

lines.zh: 我盯着一片云，直到它散。
lines.en: I stare at a cloud until it comes apart.

lines.zh: 我把自己晒暖，像一尊真正的雕像。
lines.en: I warm myself in the sun, a true statue.

lines.zh: 胸口那块石头，敲起来是空的。
lines.en: The stone in my chest rings hollow when tapped.

lines.zh: 有人在墙上刻过我的称号。
lines.en: Someone once carved my title into the wall.

lines.zh: 我梦见自己还在酒馆里数钱。
lines.en: I dream I am still counting coins in a tavern.

lines.zh: 屋顶上安静，只有我磨牙的声音。
lines.en: The roof is quiet but for my grinding teeth.

lines.zh: 菌丝从我的石缝里探出来。
lines.en: Mycelium creeps out of my cracks.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，翅膀收得很紧。
lines.en: I crouch with my wings tucked tight.

lines.zh: 原来的冒险家还留在我的手上。
lines.en: The old adventurer still shows in my hands.

lines.zh: 我听见下面有脚步，我不动。
lines.en: Footsteps below; I do not move.

lines.zh: 我低下石做的头，看清你的脸。
lines.en: I lower my stone head to study your face.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲真亮，我当年也有一副。
lines.en: Your armor gleams; I once had a set like it.

lines.zh: 你帽子歪了，风大。
lines.en: Your hat sits crooked. The wind is strong.

lines.zh: 我认得冒险家的眼神，你也有。
lines.en: I know an adventurer's eyes. Yours are the same.

lines.zh: 别喊我雕像，我记得自己叫什么。
lines.en: Do not call me a statue; I remember my name.

lines.zh: 你手里那张地图，画的是哪片山？
lines.en: That map in your hand, which hills does it show?

lines.zh: 我看你，像看从前的同伴。
lines.en: I look at you as at an old companion.

lines.zh: 你的火把离我远点，我怕烟。
lines.en: Keep your torch back; I dislike the smoke.

lines.zh: 我眼睛的裂缝里，还有一点光。
lines.en: A little light still lives in the cracks of my eyes.

lines.zh: 你想摸翅膀？先把手套戴上。
lines.en: You want to touch my wings? Put on gloves first.

lines.zh: 我认得你这双靴子走过的路。
lines.en: I know the roads those boots have walked.

lines.zh: 你看起来像会把我当成宝藏的人。
lines.en: You look like someone who would take me for treasure.

lines.zh: 石片崩开，里面是烂的。
lines.en: A chip flies off, and rot shows underneath.

lines.zh: 剑砍进石缝，卡住了。
lines.en: The sword bites into a seam and sticks.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，灰落了一身。
lines.en: I fall back a step, shedding dust.

lines.zh: 石头挨打不喊，只会掉渣。
lines.en: Stone takes a blow without a cry, shedding only grit.

lines.zh: 你砍中我名字那一边了。
lines.en: You struck the side where my name is.

lines.zh: 裂缝又长了一指。
lines.en: The crack lengthened by a finger's width.

lines.zh: 我身上的苔被打掉一片。
lines.en: A patch of moss was knocked from my back.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起自己已经死了。
lines.en: That blow reminds me I am already dead.

lines.zh: 别打头盔，那是别人的遗物。
lines.en: Not the helmet; it is someone's relic.

lines.zh: 我再硬，也经不住一直敲。
lines.en: Hard as I am, I cannot bear endless hammering.

lines.zh: 金币的声音，我隔一堵墙都听见。
lines.en: I hear coins through a wall.

lines.zh: 把亮的东西放地上，退三步。
lines.en: Set something shiny down and step back three paces.

lines.zh: 我以前也收集战利品，装满了背包。
lines.en: I collected loot too, until my pack burst.

lines.zh: 那枚戒指，成色不错。
lines.en: That ring is of good make.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我吃旧故事和金子。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; I eat old tales and gold.

lines.zh: 你把宝箱打开，我就当没看见你。
lines.en: Open the chest, and I will pretend I never saw you.

lines.zh: 地图上标红叉的地方，我去过。
lines.en: I have been to the spot your map marks.

lines.zh: 别用铁锭逗我，我咬得动。
lines.en: Do not tease me with an ingot; I can bite through it.

lines.zh: 冒险家都这样，见钱眼开。
lines.en: Adventurers are all alike, dazzled by coin.

lines.zh: 你的护符在响，是银的。
lines.en: Your charm chimes; it is silver.

lines.zh: 你撞我那一下，响得像敲了口钟。
lines.en: Your impact rang out like a struck bell.

lines.zh: 脚跟钉在石砖上，退开的是你。
lines.en: My heels stay planted in the brick; you are the one who steps back.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲比你整个人还硬。
lines.en: My pauldron is harder than your whole body.

lines.zh: 你揉着额头，我身上多了道白印。
lines.en: You rub your brow; I have a fresh white mark.

lines.zh: 别推石像，会掉渣。
lines.en: Do not shove a statue; it sheds grit.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把我的旧伤震开了。
lines.en: That bump reopened an old crack.

lines.zh: 你从左边撞过来，我从右边看你。
lines.en: You came in from the left; I watch from the right.

lines.zh: 我们撞出的灰，落在你头发上。
lines.en: The dust we raised settled in your hair.

lines.zh: 我脚下挪了半寸，就算让步。
lines.en: I shifted half an inch. Call it a concession.

lines.zh: 你该绕开，我转身很慢。
lines.en: You should go around; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 两尊石像挨着蹲，一蹲就是一季。
lines.en: Two gargoyles crouch together for a whole season.

lines.zh: 我们不动，也不说话，石头都这样。
lines.en: We neither move nor speak; stone is like that.

lines.zh: 她的头盔比我的新，名字却磨平了。
lines.en: Her helmet is newer, but her name has worn away.

lines.zh: 我们把翅膀交叠，挡一挡北风。
lines.en: We fold our wings together against the north wind.

lines.zh: 没人给我们证婚，屋檐下就算数。
lines.en: No one weds us; under the eaves is enough.

lines.zh: 我们并排守着同一段城墙。
lines.en: We guard the same stretch of wall, side by side.

lines.zh: 她敲我的肩，声音很空。
lines.en: She taps my shoulder, and it rings hollow.

lines.zh: 石像没有孩子，只有慢慢长出的苔。
lines.en: Statues bear no children, only moss that grows.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一条裂缝，正好。
lines.en: A crack runs between us, and it suits us.

lines.zh: 哪天她碎了，我就替她站那一边。
lines.en: If she breaks, I will stand her side for her.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，捡到的东西塞进裂缝。
lines.en: I have no pockets; finds go into my cracks.

lines.zh: 那枚铜币从我的指缝漏下去了。
lines.en: That copper coin slipped through my fingers.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，东西通常先被人拿走。
lines.en: I bend slowly; others usually take the find first.

lines.zh: 剑我捡得动，就是握不紧。
lines.en: I can lift a sword, but not grip it.

lines.zh: 我把宝石含在嘴里，凉得很舒服。
lines.en: I keep gems in my mouth; they feel cool.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的地图，我认得那笔迹。
lines.en: I know the hand that wrote the map on the ground.

lines.zh: 想让我放下？先掰开我的手指。
lines.en: Want me to drop it? Pry my fingers open first.

lines.zh: 我捡的不是宝贝，是以前的日子。
lines.en: What I pick up is not treasure but former days.

lines.zh: 那把钥匙我收了三十年。
lines.en: I have kept that key for thirty years.

lines.zh: 你掉的箭，我插在腰缝里。
lines.en: Your fallen arrow is tucked in my waist seam.

lines.zh: 你踏进院子，我的眼睛就亮了。
lines.en: You enter the yard, and my eyes light up.

lines.zh: 石像醒来的声音，是碎屑落地。
lines.en: A statue wakes with the sound of falling grit.

lines.zh: 我认得这种脚步声，是来抢东西的。
lines.en: I know that step; it comes to take things.

lines.zh: 你碰了那扇门，门是我的。
lines.en: You touched that door. The door is mine.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开的影子，先罩住你。
lines.en: My spreading wings cast a shadow over you first.

lines.zh: 十步，够我起身了。
lines.en: Ten paces. Enough time to rise.

lines.zh: 我转头看你，碎石从颈缝里掉。
lines.en: I turn to look at you, and grit falls from my neck seam.

lines.zh: 你想拿的，正是我守的。
lines.en: What you want is what I keep.

lines.zh: 院里每一块砖，都记着你的重量。
lines.en: Every brick here records your weight.

lines.zh: 现在跑，还来得及。
lines.en: Run now, and you may still make it.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，脚步压着你的节奏。
lines.en: I follow behind, matching my steps to yours.

lines.zh: 你拐进巷子，我从屋顶过去。
lines.en: You turn into the alley; I cross the roofs.

lines.zh: 我的影子贴着墙，和你并排跑。
lines.en: My shadow runs the wall beside you.

lines.zh: 你回头看不见我，我在你上头。
lines.en: You look back and miss me; I am above you.

lines.zh: 石头的耐心，比你的体力长。
lines.en: Stone's patience outlasts your stamina.

lines.zh: 我不喊，我的脚步声就够了。
lines.en: I do not shout; my footfalls suffice.

lines.zh: 你数着拐角，我数着你的心跳。
lines.en: You count corners; I count your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 这条街的每扇窗，我都钻过。
lines.en: I have been through every window on this street.

lines.zh: 你往亮处跑，我在暗处跟。
lines.en: You run for the light; I follow in the dark.

lines.zh: 那尊滴水兽，刚才动了一下，是我。
lines.en: That gargoyle moved a moment ago. It was me.

lines.zh: 石拳落下，砖地裂了一道。
lines.en: My stone fist lands and splits the paving.

lines.zh: 我打一下，就够你记很久。
lines.en: One blow from me is remembered a long while.

lines.zh: 爪子刮过你的护甲，火星四溅。
lines.en: My claws rake your armor, throwing sparks.

lines.zh: 我不用武器，这双手就够了。
lines.en: I need no weapon; these hands suffice.

lines.zh: 你被我打得贴在墙上。
lines.en: My strike pins you against the wall.

lines.zh: 这一拳带着三十年的力气。
lines.en: This punch carries thirty years of strength.

lines.zh: 翅膀扫过来，比拳头更疼。
lines.en: My wing sweeps in, worse than the fist.

lines.zh: 我砸下去，你脚边的石板碎了。
lines.en: I slam down and the flagstone at your feet breaks.

lines.zh: 石屑混着你的血，落在一起。
lines.en: Stone chips and your blood fall together.

lines.zh: 挨完这一下，你该明白谁是主人。
lines.en: After this blow, you will know who owns the place.

lines.zh: 我从一具冒险家的尸体里站起来。
lines.en: I rose out of an adventurer's corpse.

lines.zh: 十个里只有三个能变成我这样。
lines.en: Only three in ten become what I am.

lines.zh: 我的头盔是从死人头上取的。
lines.en: My helmet came off a dead man's head.

lines.zh: 石头一点点裹住我，先裹住脚。
lines.en: Stone wrapped me slowly, starting at the feet.

lines.zh: 我醒来时，名字还刻在额头上。
lines.en: When I woke, my name was still carved on my brow.

lines.zh: 这身石壳不是天生的。
lines.en: This stone hide was not born with me.

lines.zh: 我记得断气前的最后一句祷词。
lines.en: I recall the last prayer before my breath stopped.

lines.zh: 苔先长在我的关节上。
lines.en: Moss grew first in my joints.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，屋顶已经塌了一半。
lines.en: I opened my eyes to a half-collapsed roof.

lines.zh: 第一件事是找我的剑，没找到。
lines.en: My first act was to seek my sword. It was gone.

lines.zh: 有只猫在我胸口睡了整夜。
lines.en: A cat slept on my chest all night.

lines.zh: 我站起来时，整面墙都在响。
lines.en: When I stood, the whole wall groaned.

lines.zh: 火烧不化石头，只烧掉我的苔。
lines.en: Fire will not melt stone, only my moss.

lines.zh: 我从屋檐掉下去，砸碎了铺地。
lines.en: I fell from the eaves and shattered the paving.

lines.zh: 我在水底走，水进不了石壳。
lines.en: I walk the riverbed; water cannot enter my shell.

lines.zh: 炸掉我半边肩，剩下的还能动。
lines.en: The blast took half my shoulder; the rest still moves.

lines.zh: 箭撞在石头上，弹开了。
lines.en: The arrow struck stone and glanced away.

lines.zh: 魔法在我身上打了个滑。
lines.en: Magic slips off my stone skin.

lines.zh: 石像饿起来，只想啃石灰。
lines.en: A hungry statue craves only lime.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我从里到外亮了一回。
lines.en: Lightning struck, and I lit up from within.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有石头可以落。
lines.en: In the void there is no stone to land on.
